trap-negation-contrast.notes: STRUCTURAL MATH FLAGS (not traps, reported not fixed). (1) DIRECT SUM WHERE A PRODUCT IS NEEDED. The trace display reads tr_F(e_sym^EW . e_H) = dim_q(e_sym^EW[A^(W+) DIRECT-SUM A^(W-) DIRECT-SUM A^(Z)]) . dim_q(e_H . A^(H)), and the next step multiplies [4]_q . [4]_q . [6]_q. A q-dimension is ADDITIVE over a direct sum: [4]+[4]+[6] = 14.607, and times [2]_q that is 29.374, not 216.96. To get the product the middle object has to be a TENSOR product (which the name 'symmetric-channel' suggests was intended). As written the derivation of N_sym does not follow from its own display. (2) e_H's TRACE CONTRADICTS ITS RANK. (G-4) calls e_H a rank-1 projector isolating 'the unbroken 1-dimensional subspace of A^(H)', then assigns it trace dimension [2]_q - the value (G-2) gives to ALL of A^(H). A rank-1 sub-object cannot carry the q-dimension of the rank-2 object containing it. (G-2)'s own wording is ambiguous on the same point ('the q-dimension of the fundamental representation, restricted to the neutral component' - the fundamental is 2-dimensional, the neutral component 1-dimensional). (3) POSSIBLE FOURTH CALIBRATION. (G-3) fixes tr_F(rho_Phi* . rho_Phi) = v^2/m_e^2 with v ~ 246 GeV, described in the block as 'the empirical Higgs VEV'. That is an empirical input outside CAL-1/2/3 (m_e, D_beta, D_pi). Mitigating: (G-4) divides by exactly that trace, so v cancels out of e_H and never reaches N_sym - worth saying so explicitly, since the authorNotes claim every factor is derived and not fitted. (4) UNSOURCED TARGET. 'the CODATA target N_sym(q_0) = 213.11' carries no citation, no derivation and no witness field; computation.status in the .ts is 'not_run'. The whole -1.81 % headline rests on it. (5) TABLE 1 (tbl:g-action-on-substrate-table1-data): the photon row is assigned the trivial irrep (0,0) while the Z row is assigned the mixed '(1,0) restricted to (T^3, Y)'. Both gamma and Z are W^3-B mixtures, so the asymmetry is wrong in the same way for gamma; and the last row 'residual matter sector / leptons + quarks' is not an irrep at all, contradicting (G-1)'s 'each A^(X) carries a unique irreducible representation of G'. (6) TABLE 2 calls the [4]_q, [4]_q, [6]_q entries 'Goldstone at W-host / Z-host', but the body assigns those q-dimensions to the gauge components A^(W+-), A^(Z); Goldstones are the eaten scalars of the Higgs doublet, so the two namings disagree. (7) TABLE 3 is work-tracking, not content: its rows are audit flags and their disposition ('HIGGS-SLOT | retraction | ...', 'section 3.A v4 calibration | wrong direction | ...'), and the 'post-discharge' column describes a state that does not yet hold. This is the AGENTS.md section 4d authorNotes case and should migrate out of the rendered paper.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: NUMERICS RECOMPUTED (mpmath, 50 dps). Convention identified: the bracket is the BALANCED q-integer [n]_q = sum_{k} q^{n-1-2k}. At the proton pin q_0 = 1.1099785827513808: [2]_q = 2.0108969 (block quotes 2.0109, ok), [4]_q = 4.1096824 so [4]_q^2 = 16.88949, [6]_q = 6.3880866 (block quotes 6.388, ok), and [2]_q [4]_q^2 [6]_q = 216.9587226 (block quotes ~216.96, ok). Residual (213.11 - 216.9587)/213.11 = -1.80598 %, so the quoted -1.81 % is right. TWO NUMERIC DEFECTS: (i) the block writes 16.892 for [4]_q^2; the correct value is 16.8895. 16.892 is what you get by squaring a 3-figure [4]_q = 4.11 (4.11^2 = 16.8921), i.e. round-then-square. (ii) The displayed line is internally inconsistent - multiplying the three quoted literals gives 2.0109 x 16.892 x 6.388 = 216.9884, not the 216.96 stated on the same line; the 216.96 was evidently computed from unrounded values. PIN CURRENCY: the numbers do NOT distinguish the pins - proton gives 216.9587226 and muon (1.10997859555733471) gives 216.9587285, identical to 8 figures - but they DO exclude the 1.1097 rounding, which gives 216.8325 and a residual of -1.7468 % (would print as -1.75 %, not -1.81 %). So the block reproduces a full-precision q_0, either pin. Note the .ts computation.witness is computations/q-pinning-50-digit.witness.json, which is the MUON-pinned anchor, with computation.status 'not_run'.
